newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-James Hardie confirms U.S. expansion.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-James Hardie confirms U.S. expansion.

text.p: Building products group James Hardie Industries Ltd said on Friday it planned to speed up the expansion of its U.S. fibre cement building products plants to meet growing demand.

James Hardie spokesman Bill Frew said that the company still planned to increase production to about 800 million square feet (msf) from its current 340 msf, but would speed up the expansion to ensure it was finished by the end of the year to March 31, 1998.
"We need to get to a total of 800 million square feet in a slightly different way and slightly faster," Frew told Reuters.
